Method of Attack: Monitors browser activity, takes screenshots, steals cryptocurrency through scripts injected in web pages
Mimics benign Google Drive extensions to hide
Modifies browser shortcut files to automate execution
Attaches listener to monitor tab switches, web content, and page loads
